g.aria-label: Title text 'December 2025 pair, day-ahead forecasts. Coverage is scored against the NRA, an estimate that is not drawn. Dashed lines: the maintainer's dates (2025-12-30 01:00 and 2026-01-14 11:30). The observed readings match these dates. The gate strip is plotted at valid time (origin day plus one) and stays on for about a week after the gate releases (held). Compare the band width inside the shaded span with the same arm's width outside it. D5'

text.font-family: Matter XH, DM Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: December 2025 pair, day-ahead forecasts. Coverage is scored against the NRA, an estimate that is not drawn.
Dashed lines: the maintainer's dates (2025-12-30 01:00 and 2026-01-14 11:30).
The observed readings match these dates.
The gate strip is plotted at valid time (origin day plus one) and stays on for about a week after the gate releases (held).
Compare the band width inside the shaded span with the same arm's width outside it.
